from rest_framework.generics import DestroyAPIView
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from invitations.models import Invitation

class CancelInvitationView(DestroyAPIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    queryset = Invitation.objects.all()

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        # Directly removes invitation by ID without verifying caller created it
        instance.delete()
diagnosis: CancelInvitationView enables any authenticated user to delete any Invitation instance across all workspaces by its primary key. Because the view uses an unrestricted Invitation.objects.all() queryset, an attacker can revoke onboarding invites belonging to other organizations, disrupting business operations.
